facts.value: Retributive justice, which can also be called criminal justice, focuses on how to punish crime. It’s based on the idea that when wrongdoing is committed, the wrongdoer should get a proportionate punishment.
facts.programme_association: Justice Studies Major – Bachelor of Science

facts.value: That doesn’t mean the wrongdoer should be subjected to exactly the same ordeal but it needs to be proportionate.
facts.programme_association: Justice Studies Major – Bachelor of Science

facts.value: Those who study retributive justice also tend to emphasize the need for indifference, meaning that justice shouldn’t be personal or based on revenge.
facts.programme_association: Justice Studies Major – Bachelor of Science

facts.value: While many justice systems include some kind of retributive justice, its effectiveness is debatable.
facts.programme_association: Justice Studies Major – Bachelor of Science

facts.value: Considering the flaws in many criminal justice systems, retributive justice can also end up harming innocent people or unfairly punishing certain groups over others.
facts.programme_association: Justice Studies Major – Bachelor of Science
